list.label: PG Cluster
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'cnpg_backends_total' AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] != ''

list.name: instance
list.label: PG Instance
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'cnpg_backends_total' AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] IN (${cluster:singlequote}) AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] != ''

targets.rawSql:
SELECT LogAttributes['query_id'] AS query_id,
       any(LogAttributes['db.query.text']) AS query,
       any(LogAttributes['db.name']) AS database,
       count() AS calls,
       round(avg(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['duration_us'])) / 1000, 2) AS avg_ms,
       round(quantile(0.99)(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['duration_us'])) / 1000, 2) AS p99_ms
FROM otel.otel_logs
WHERE ServiceName = 'pg_stat_ch'
  AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] IN (${cluster:singlequote}) AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] IN (${instance:singlequote})
  AND LogAttributes['query_id'] = '$query_id'
GROUP BY query_id

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL 60 SECOND) AS time,
       ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] AS cluster, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS instance,
       avg(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['duration_us'])) / 1000 AS avg_ms
FROM otel.otel_logs
WHERE ServiceName = 'pg_stat_ch' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
  AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] IN (${cluster:singlequote}) AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] IN (${instance:singlequote})
  AND ('$query_id' = '' OR LogAttributes['query_id'] = '$query_id')
GROUP BY time, cluster, instance
ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL 60 SECOND) AS time,
       ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] AS cluster, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS instance,
       sum(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['shared_blks_read'])) / 60 AS blks_read_per_sec
FROM otel.otel_logs
WHERE ServiceName = 'pg_stat_ch' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
  AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] IN (${cluster:singlequote}) AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] IN (${instance:singlequote})
  AND ('$query_id' = '' OR LogAttributes['query_id'] = '$query_id')
GROUP BY time, cluster, instance
ORDER BY time

SELECT TraceId AS trace,
       min(Timestamp) AS started,
       count() AS spans,
       round(max(Duration) / 1e6, 2) AS total_ms
FROM otel.otel_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] IN (${cluster:singlequote}) AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] IN (${instance:singlequote})
  AND ('$query_id' = '' OR SpanAttributes['query.query_id'] = '$query_id')
GROUP BY TraceId
ORDER BY total_ms DESC
LIMIT 20

WITH '$trace_id' AS __gf_trace_id,
     (SELECT min(Start) FROM otel.otel_traces_trace_id_ts
       WHERE TraceId = __gf_trace_id) AS __gf_start,
     (SELECT max(End) + 1 FROM otel.otel_traces_trace_id_ts
       WHERE TraceId = __gf_trace_id) AS __gf_end
SELECT TraceId AS traceID,
       SpanId AS spanID,
       ParentSpanId AS parentSpanID,
       ServiceName AS serviceName,
       SpanName AS operationName,
       multiply(toUnixTimestamp64Nano(Timestamp), 0.000001) AS startTime,
       multiply(Duration, 0.000001) AS duration,
       arrayMap(k -> map('key', k, 'value', SpanAttributes[k]),
                mapKeys(SpanAttributes)) AS tags,
       arrayMap(k -> map('key', k, 'value', ResourceAttributes[k]),
                mapKeys(ResourceAttributes)) AS serviceTags,
       SpanAttributes['query.query_id'] AS queryId
FROM otel.otel_traces
WHERE TraceId = __gf_trace_id
  AND Timestamp >= __gf_start
  AND Timestamp <= __gf_end
ORDER BY startTime ASC

SELECT Timestamp AS time,
       SeverityText AS level,
       ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS instance,
       JSON_VALUE(Body, '$.command_tag') AS command,
       JSON_VALUE(Body, '$.user_name') AS user,
       toFloat64OrNull(extract(JSONExtractString(Body, 'message'), 'duration: ([0-9.]+) ms')) AS ms,
       extract(JSONExtractString(Body, 'message'), 'ms  (parse|bind|execute)') AS phase,
       LogAttributes['query_id'] AS query_id,
       LogAttributes['sql_state_code'] AS sqlstate,
       substring(JSONExtractString(Body, 'message'), 1, 200) AS message
FROM otel.otel_logs
WHERE ServiceName = 'postgres-server-log'
  AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
  AND '$trace_id' != '' AND position(Body, '$trace_id') > 0
ORDER BY Timestamp DESC
LIMIT 100

SELECT Timestamp AS time,
       round(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['duration_us']) / 1000, 3) AS ms,
       LogAttributes['rows'] AS rows_returned,
       LogAttributes['shared_blks_hit'] AS blks_hit,
       LogAttributes['shared_blks_read'] AS blks_read,
       LogAttributes['parallel_workers_launched'] AS workers,
       ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] AS cluster, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS instance
FROM otel.otel_logs
WHERE ServiceName = 'pg_stat_ch'
  AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
  AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] IN (${cluster:singlequote}) AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] IN (${instance:singlequote})
  AND ('$query_id' = '' OR LogAttributes['query_id'] = '$query_id')
ORDER BY Timestamp DESC
LIMIT 100

       LogAttributes['query_id'] AS query_id,
       LogAttributes['sql_state_code'] AS sqlstate,
       substring(JSONExtractString(Body, 'message'), 1, 200) AS message
FROM otel.otel_logs
WHERE ServiceName = 'postgres-server-log'

ORDER BY Timestamp DESC
